_doc: Layouts of the five Hoài Nam towns for the battle cinema at 1 unit = 1 m (src/world/huainan-cinema.js → Battle.siege / Battle.stage in src/world/battle.js), in the data/cities.json entry format (outline in km, x east, z south; gates per side; passages; que; moat; houses; palaces; features; river sides). County-town scale (a side of 0.3–0.6 km, drawn 1:1 by Battle.plan) and the town model of the map (han-models.js HM.town): a square with one gate a side, the governor's compound north of the centre facing south, the watchtower at the crossroads, the market to the south-east, the granaries to the north-east. `walls` is the lũy the scenario starts with; the wall's height, the khuyết and the moat follow the lũy the battle is fought at (byWalls, indexed by lũy 0–4, as the map: khuyết from 2, a moat from 3). River sides from the baked map (assets/map/water.json: the Huai north-west of Chung Ly and Thọ Xuân, the Yangtze along the east of Lịch Dương) and data/scenario/huainan.json (Hu Dị on the Huai; Âm Lăng inland).
